dedupe_keys.name: bdtre nodo della rete elettrica nd ele

description: BDTRE - Nodo della rete elettrica (ND_ELE) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.csi.it. It belongs to the stratum of the "Networks of Subservices", theme "Electricity Network" of the "Content Specifications for Geotopographical DBs" drawn up at national level. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "BDTRE - Power Grid Node (ND_ELE)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include BDTRE, opendata, classe BDTRE, RNDT. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2019-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
